images.caption: Figure 1:Overview ofAmbitcapabilities.(1) Spatial audio generationcreates multi-source 3D scenes from text, controlling content, timing, and trajectories.(2) Instruction-guided spatial and temporal editingmodifies selected sources, preserving unmodified content and spatial structure.

Figure 2:Overview ofAmbit.(a)A shared Transformer predicts executableScenePlans
and renders native FOA through latent flow conditioned on compiled plans.
Editing uses source latents in both modes andAmbitCLAP features
in planning.(b)OPSD distills token and clean latent predictions on student
prefixes and visited states, jointly updating the shared Transformer
and AR/DiT modules.(c)The VAE combines shared-decoder auxiliaryWWreconstruction,
grouped KL, and spatial covariance supervision.
